gloss: to rot away completely; to fall into ruin; to die forgotten

definitions.gloss: to rot away completely; to crumble into ruin
definitions.explanation: For wood, a building or other object to decay until it is useless or falls apart.

definitions.gloss: to die in obscurity; to end one's days forgotten
definitions.explanation: Figurative: for a person to live out their life, or die, without recognition or success. Literary.

notes:
⟦{朽|く}ちる→朽ちる：18727_kuchiru⟧ (to rot, to decay) + ⟦{果|は}てる→果てる：28565_hateru⟧ (to come to an end, completely). Like other 〜⟦{果|は}てる→果てる：28565_hateru⟧ verbs (⟦{疲|つか}れ{果|は}てる→疲れ果てる：17963_tsukarehateru⟧, ⟦{変|か}わり→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦{果|は}てる→果てる：28565_hateru⟧), it stresses that the process has gone all the way.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朽|く}ち{果|は}てた⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: a ruined building
- {朽|く}ち{果|は}てた⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧: a rotting wreck
- ⟦{異国|いこく}→異国：13721_ikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{朽|く}ち{果|は}てる: to die forgotten in a foreign land
